title: Ordinary equality on a signature or MAC (python)
description: Code in python compares a signature, digest, or HMAC with ordinary equality. Ordinary comparison returns at the first differing byte, so response timing can reveal how much of the expected value matched. This lexical rule flags the comparison; the reviewer switches to hmac.compare_digest.
remediation: Compare authentication values with a constant-time function such as the one named in the safe alternative.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches identifiers containing signature, digest, or hmac. It does not prove the value is secret or that timing is observable.
